items.briefing:
AI-related security incidents are on the rise globally, with new research highlighting how criminals are exploiting AI tools in unexpected ways — a trend directly relevant to Australian organisations using AI in their operations. Separately, a report from 404 Media notes that major AI companies are grappling with concerns about AI systems degrading the quality of online information, which may affect how reliably staff can trust web-based research.

US cybersecurity agency CISA has shifted from weekly vulnerability summaries to a risk-based approach, meaning security teams may need to adjust how they monitor for software threats. **Practical tip:** If your organisation uses AI tools, ensure staff know to verify important information from authoritative sources rather than relying solely on AI-generated responses.

featured.title: Samsung brings One UI 9 to Galaxy S26 in Australia
featured.summary: Australian Galaxy S26 owners will gain Samsung's latest AI tools and tighter privacy controls from late September.
